subject.event: Measurable precipitation at London Heathrow on 12 August 2026
subject.outcomeDefinition: Total precipitation exceeding 0.2 mm recorded at station EGLL between 00:00 and 23:59 UTC on 2026-08-12, per the Met Office daily climate record published within 72 hours of that date.
subject.resolutionSource: Met Office daily climate record for station EGLL

falsifiability.basis: The Met Office record for 12 August 2026 does not exist yet; the day it describes falls after this record was generated, and nothing in producing this prediction determines what falls at Heathrow.

interval.method: bootstrap over 2000 resamples of the analogue-day set

baseline.source: Met Office 1991-2020 climatological normals for EGLL
baseline.basis: Proportion of 12 August dates with precipitation above 0.2 mm across the 30-year normal period, n = 30.

sampleSize.basis: Days since 2016 whose 500 hPa synoptic pattern matched the current analysis within the classifier's similarity threshold, restricted to August and the two adjacent weeks.

knownGaps: Radar coverage for the western approach was degraded for six hours on 2026-08-07; the affected period is excluded from the analogue set.
Two of the 1240 analogue days lack upper-air soundings and use reanalysis instead.

outliers.handling: Three analogue days carried precipitation totals above the 99.5th percentile, all associated with convective events under a comparable synoptic pattern. They were retained: the convective mechanism is present in the current analysis, so these are evidence about the tail rather than contamination. Retaining them widened the interval by roughly 0.03.

regime.description: The classifier was refitted in March 2026 on data through 2025. No station relocation, instrumentation change, or reporting-threshold change has occurred at EGLL since. Synoptic regime is within the range represented in the training period.

aggregation.note: Weights fixed in the March 2026 refit from out-of-sample log score, before any of these members saw the current case.

calibration.method: Brier score with reliability decomposition, 10 probability bins
calibration.dataset: All EGLL daily precipitation predictions from 2025-08-01 to 2026-07-31, n = 365, strictly out of sample for the March 2026 refit.
